label: Game A
nuance_found: One verb (the tide lantern) with real opposing demands: the causeway needs low sea, the well and boat-floating need high sea, crossing deep water drowns you, the Needles need a narrow band that shifts per arch (too low hits reefs, too high hits the arch with the mast), crabs own the sand at low water. The Undertow boss is a three-phase tide pattern (lure high, strand low, slam high, shine) that gets warier each round. Tam and Nell shout the hints, so the system is taught by feedback, not guessed.
audio: Looping wind/ambience, a harbour/flats/boss music change per zone, a tide-creak tone on every sea move, thumps when scraping, rising chimes on objectives.
furthest_progress: Completed the full main line at ~530 s: harbour, well shard, Tam's boat, Shellflats wreck lens, Needles by boat, stepping stones to the Stack, beat the Undertow in 3 phases, lit the lamp, got the end card (9 min, 82 m of sea moved, 11 knocks, 0 of 5 lost things found). Never found Marta's pots.
control_trouble: Needles minigame needed lantern held with a finger and small moves; camera occluded by a plank at the lighthouse door; several long black screens I could not read.
best_moment: The Undertow: luring the giant hermit crab in on high water, stranding it, then slamming the sea back to lift its boat shell.
worst_moment: Hero respawn at 34,-40 got stuck in a drown loop with a black screen for about a minute when I raised the sea too high at the wreck, and the side-quest pots never pointed me anywhere.
verdict: This is the first one in a while where the one verb has teeth. Every place asks the tide to be somewhere different, and the lantern is also your fail state, so I was constantly trading reach against safety. The Needles and the Undertow actually changed how I played, and the NPCs teach it without a tutorial wall. It looks and sounds finished on a phone. Faults: black frames on transitions, a drown-respawn soft-lock, the pots side quest invisible, and the main line is short (about 9 min). I would play it again and show friends.
